Exact weighted adapted-frame dual theorem: if G_ad>=R>0 then Adv^{<=D}(P,Q)^2<=b^T R^{-1}b; diagonal weights give sum_S |<h,psi_S>|^2/w_S.
Exact moving-frame differentiation identities under exponential Gibbs interpolation and exact relative-derivative-to-Loewner integration theorem.
Exact Johnson-scheme eigenvalues for the exchangeable degree-two adapted pair frame: lambda0=a+2(n-2)b+C(n-2,2)c, lambda1=1+(n-4)r-(n-3)q, lambda2=1-2r+q, normalized by a=1-r^2.

For high-temperature Curie-Weiss beta<1, degree-two normalized eigenvalues tend 1, 1/(1-beta), 1/(1-beta)^2 while the absolute off-diagonal row sum tends 2 alpha+alpha^2 and exceeds 1 for beta>1-1/sqrt(2).
Curie-Weiss also has the dimension-free pointwise density lower bound dQ_beta/dU >= sqrt(1-beta), giving a complete signed norm lower comparison in this special model.
